title: Warm-up
how: The word SECRET was painted over the photo in white, at 15% strength.
plain: It's like writing on a window with a nearly dry marker: faint, but there if you look closely.

title: Fading ink
how: The same white word SECRET, but fainter: only 10% strength.
plain: The marker is running out, so the writing is even harder to see.

title: Almost invisible
how: The word SECRET at just 2% strength, too faint for most eyes.
plain: The ink is so faint that you need the booster to make it stand out.

title: Bit 3
how: A black-and-white picture of the word HELLO was written into bit 3 of every colour number.
plain: Every colour number was nudged by up to 8 out of 255. That's small, but the X-ray shows the word clearly.

title: Bit 2
how: A picture of the word SPY was written into bit 2 of every colour number.
plain: Smaller nudges this time, up to 4 out of 255, so your eyes can't see them.

title: Bit 1
how: A picture of the word AGENT was written into bit 1 of every colour number.
plain: Each colour changed by 2 at most. Only a look at that one bit gives it away.

title: The last bit
how: A picture of the word FOUND ME was written into the last bit (bit 0) of every colour number.
plain: Like changing every price in a shop by one cent: nobody notices, but look only at the cents and a word appears.

title: Only in blue
how: A picture of the words CODE 42 was written into the last bit of the blue numbers only.
plain: The secret is only in the blue paint, so you have to check the right colour.

title: Photo inside a photo
how: A whole second photo, of a hiker, was hidden in the last two bits of every colour number.
plain: The rough outline of another photo is tucked into the tiniest part of each pixel, like a ghost underneath.

title: Postage stamp
how: A tiny smiley picture was written into the last bit of the green numbers, in one busy corner.
plain: Like a stamp dropped in a messy room: the right tool shows it, but you still have to look everywhere.
